_comment: Brown kraft cardboard: the unbleached board of boxes, cartons and paper bags. Opaque, a matte dielectric fibre sheet, from an ambientCG scan (L3). Placed in engineered/composite as the wish list does: the class's boundary is not written yet (O11), so the home is provisional. Carries the row's wear layers at 0 (C1): scuffs (overlay 1, damage) and dust as a deposit (overlay 2), gated by the Patches mask, whose channels fit that order (G damage patches, B deposit drifts); overlay 3 is empty, as the row has it. The row's damage layer, Creases01, is not made yet; Scuffs01 stands in for it in slot 1. Drafted by /matter-generate for the Kitchen_set look; Storm only, not rigged.
name: Cardboard_Kraft_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: Physically Based has no cardboard entry; the scan's mean linear albedo (0.49, 0.28, 0.07) is a plausible unbleached kraft and is kept. ambientCG gives no physical size for Cardboard002; a 0.1 m tile (its sibling Paper004, a kraft paper, is 0.3 m) keeps its fibre mottling at a few millimetres. specular_ior 1.5, a generic cellulose dielectric.
